headline: Uzbekistan's Exports Surge 33% to $25.7 Billion in First Ten Months of Year
summary: Official statistics revealed that Uzbekistan's total exports increased 33% year-on-year to reach $25.7 billion between January and October.
why: Uzbekistan is Central Asia's most populous market; rapid export expansion highlights economic diversification and integration along regional trade corridors.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Uzbekistan recorded a 33% expansion in export receipts over ten months.
